review_description: The site inspection went and quoting went well.  All questions were answered.Installation was completed in less time that expected.  Staff were pleasant and competent.Connection of the inverter to the wifi could not be completed on the day and a subsequent appointment has been organized.The grid connection was not discussed.  I assumed it was part of the installation.

We have just completed a massive renovation, covering virtually every part of our house, and our experience with Macedon Ranges Solar was by far the worst part of the entire process.  The initial installation was done wrongly, so that every panel had to be removed and reinstalled.  We then had a number of ongoing issues with the operation of the system.  In spite of this, Luke (owner) insisted that we pay in full before the installers would leave.  Knowing how he operates, I can understand why.  They've basically disappeared on us since then, and it took the threat of the ombudsman to get him to answer my emails and resolve the last remaining issues.Now that the work is basically complete, I am getting zero support when required.  No phone calls returned, no emails replied to. I would go anywhere other than Macedon Ranges Solar.

Very easy to deal with and down to earth. Being local means they understood my needs (panels on rural shed with a cable back to my switchboard). I was offered REC panels (high quality) at a discounted price. Quality of the installation is great, with dual inverters, however only issue was bits of cable tied were left strewn on the ground around the shed. The electrical install had some hiccups with circuit breakers tripping after on sunny days but that seems to be sorted now after a couple of follow up visits and upgraded units fitted.I have 2 x 5kW systems, each connected to its own phase (2 phase power). Works really well. 32 panels total.Definitely recommend Macedon Ranges Solar Power. Small company and you get to know the individuals. Customer service is very good and are competitive in pricing.
Macedon Ranges Solar was very responsive , terrific communication and a good price.  The system installed us working very well and has quality components
From initial quote to installation the process was made easy.  The whole team were professional and friendly. I would highly recommend Macedon Ranges Solar.

We were pleased that they came to the house to look/see where we wanted the panels placed, not just a recommendation from a drone photo! Installation was quick.The crew that came were lovely and polite and arrived when they said they would.Everything was returned to its original place and there was absolutely nothing left behind in the way of rubbish.All installation was handled by the company including final inspection by the appropriate authoritiesHighly recommended!

Most expensive quote but no-push advice, technical site inspection before installation, and good communication. Neat installation on time, and w a subsequent inspection for grid connection within a week.
Very Professional organisation. The best service and best advice. Matt came out and didn’t over sell our solution. Gave us realistic outcomes which was a nice change.

From the first meeting to the calls with the owner to clarify technical information/queries and to the installation, service was first rate. The installers took pride in their work and were polite, performed neat installation and were on time and ensured everything was working properly. They also gave good advice on different options for the make up of the system.Would recommend wholeheartedly.

MRSP was prompt to visit and quote, not pushy, and were more than happy to answer any questions i had.The installers were brilliant, took time to hide cables in a double story wall cavity, and after they finished, tidied up and took all rubbish away.Unable to fault their workmanship.

We went with a local business recommended to us by others who have had installations completed. When in a country town, always found it worthwhile using locals where possible.Quoting process honest and straightforward. Installation was done quickly, done very neatly.After installation, they handled every detail until the system was connected to our retailer. Also very helpful and patient in assisting the setup of our app for monitoring production.Could not have asked for more.

I sought 3 quote and received them quickly. Once I made the decision to go with MRSP they had the system installed within 2 weeks. We are not yet connected to the grid as I am waiting for the final inspection which MRSP have committed to organising. Once the STC and SolarVic rebates have been discounted I paid $7200 for the system.

They got the job because they were a bit cheaper and they addressed my questions very positively. They did a really great job and their paperwork was all done good for the rebate which will go through soon hopefully. I would recommend them for sure but check out Solar Quotes to know what to ask.

Quotation process informative and followed up with a pre-installation inspection. MRSP very helpful with the rebate process. Installation carried out by two polite and diligent staff members.  Installation is neat and functioning to specifications. Grid connection formalities to be finalised with retailer. MRSP has in hand. Overall very satisfied customers.

Solar quotes an invaluable service for accurate no BS information.Installation by Macedon Ranges Solar was quick, efficient and professional including preparation of compliance paperwork (Thanks Tilly).There was some delay with the retailer due to old contact info and Solar Victoria with a clerical error but a call to them quickly had this sorted.
Thanks for making it easy to choose from reputable companies. We're now reaping the benefits.

Macedon Ranges Solar have installed today. Quality components at a good price. Looking forward to seeing my power bills plummet. Install guys were courteous and friendly and was very happy with the way installation went. Early days but confident in this company. Thanks Matt and Luke

Our thanks to Luke and his hard working people who worked onsite.  Our system was installed on time under pretty tough conditions.  It is now up and running, all within 24 hours.  Of course, the savings we might make, only time will tell, but our experience with the people from Macedon Ranges Solar Power was excellent. Our sales contact, Matt was very helpful.  Highly recommended.
